idea-plugin.name: Nordsky Theme
idea-plugin.description: Two deep-navy dark themes with matching editor colour schemes. Nordsky: blue keywords, green strings, orange keys and constants, teal types and coral numbers. Nordsky Console: the terminal look with red strings, green numbers and grey annotations. Both cover the whole IDE UI and the editor for Java, Kotlin, XML, YAML, JSON, shell, Markdown and every language that uses the platform's default text attributes.
